=== start task ===
scripts/deploy.sh:98:  mise run generate-app-wrapper
mise.toml:93:depends = ["generate-app-wrapper"]
=== fnox.toml ===
#:schema https://fnox.jdx.dev/schema.json

env = "exec"
if_missing = "error"

[providers]
onepassword = { type = "1password", vault = "Elterngeld Engineering" }

[secrets]
POSTHOG_CLI_API_KEY = { provider = "onepassword", value = "Posthog/credential", description = "PostHog personal API key, used by posthog-cli to pull the event schema" }

[profiles.staging.secrets]
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID = { provider = "onepassword", value = "Platform Staging Object Storage/username", description = "Access key id of the staging bucket" }
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY = { provider = "onepassword", value = "Platform Staging Object Storage/credential", description = "Secret key of the staging bucket" }

[profiles.production.secrets]
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID = { provider = "onepassword", value = "Platform Production Object Storage/username", description = "Access key id of the production bucket" }
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY = { provider = "onepassword", value = "Platform Production Object Storage/credential", description = "Secret key of the production bucket" }

observation.command: cd /workspace && ls scripts/ && echo "=== start task ===" && grep -rn "generate-app-wrapper" scripts/ mise.toml && echo "=== fnox.toml ===" && cat fnox.toml
